title: The Montreal Screwjob

segments.voice: November 9, 1997. Montreal. The most controversial finish in wrestling history.
Bret Hart, on his way out to WCW, defends the WWF Championship against Shawn Michaels.
Michaels locks Bret in Bret's own Sharpshooter.
Bret never taps. But Vince McMahon orders the bell rung, and Michaels is champion.
Bret spits on Vince, and the night gives birth to the evil Mr. McMahon character.
Betrayal, or business? What would you have done?

caption:
HE NEVER TAPPED. The night Vince McMahon screwed Bret Hart.
Survivor Series 1997 changed wrestling forever and created the Mr. McMahon character. Was Vince right, or was it the ultimate betrayal?
